'''Atsuko Yuya''' (Japanese: '''湯屋敦子''' ''Yuya Atsuko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Yuya was born on September 1, 1968, in {{wp|Nagasaki}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced [[Oleana]]. Yuya is currently affiliated with {{wp|Theatre Company Subaru|Gekidan Subaru}}.
